title: Returning Customer Goodwill on Rate Lock Commitment Extension Disputes
content:
### Returning Customer Credit holders and Rate Lock Commitment extension disputes

Larkspur adds loyalty goodwill days to the relief days of a disputed extension for a borrower whose loan file carries a Larkspur Returning Customer Credit. The credit is a **Closing Cost Credit**. Its status, and the award entry on the credit ledger, are read from that credit's records.

**Rule.**

- When that credit is verified or applied and its award entry is booked on the credit ledger, the verified loyalty goodwill of **2** days is added.
- When it is only reserved, the reserved loyalty goodwill of **1** day is added.
- Otherwise none are added.

The relief days, these goodwill days included, are never below zero and never more than the disputed extension's charged days.

| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit on the loan file | Award entry booked on the credit ledger | Loyalty goodwill days |
|---|---|---|
| Verified | Yes | 2 |
| Applied | Yes | 2 |
| Verified or applied | No | 0 |
| Reserved | Either | 1 |
| Expired, forfeited or revoked | Either | 0 |
| No such credit on the file | — | 0 |

*Hypothetical case:* a borrower's file carries a Larkspur Returning Customer Credit in verified status, but no award entry has been booked on the credit ledger. No loyalty goodwill is added. Once the award entry is booked, 2 days are added.
